body:
This ticket has two parts that ship together: part 1 makes skill-rot read only invocations as commands, and part 2 fixes the links in deployed plugin markdown. Part 2's B-AC4 relies on part 1's R4. Specs: `.adlc/specs/skill-rot-command-claims.md` (part 1) and `.adlc/specs/deployed-doc-links.md` (part 2). PART 1 — SKILL-ROT COMMAND CLAIMS. PROBLEM. `packages/skill-rot/lib/extract-claims.mjs` `processInlineCode` turns every backtick span that is not path-like into a `command` claim when its first whitespace token matches /^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*$/. `verify-claims.mjs` then reports `command not found`. API names, option names, tool names, model ids, enum values and file names written in backticks therefore all go stale, so the gate is noise and nobody can use it to notice real rot. `processCodeLine` does the same for every line of every fenced block, whatever its language, so TypeScript (`const`), YAML and box-drawing diagrams (`Vague request, no ticket yet? ───→`) become commands too. EVIDENCE (measured on this branch's base, upstream/main 780c3400, with the in-tree extractor). (1) The deployed OpenCode router `plugins/adlc-opencode/skill/adlc.md`, checked as `.opencode/skills/adlc/SKILL.md` in a consumer repository (adlc CLI 1.12.0), is stale on `adversarial-review`, `execute.before`, `edit` (from "`edit`/`write`") and `advisoryHooks`: 4 of its 6 stale claims are false positives. (2) the same consumer repository's `.agents/skills`: 47 skills, 0 clean, 46 stale; inline spans give 167 ok and 905 stale command claims (for example `retry.maxAttempts`, `typescript`, `node_modules`, `SKILL.md`, `server.baseUrl`, `lint-rules.profile.yml`, `gpt-4.1-mini`, `claude-sonnet-4-5`). (3) This repo's 30 tracked SKILL.md files: inline spans give 131 ok and 167 stale; unlabelled fences give 42 stale diagram lines; `bash`/`sh` fences give 80 ok and 2 stale. WHAT TO BUILD. The full design, the alternatives weighed and the measurements are in `.adlc/specs/skill-rot-command-claims.md`. Normative rules: - R1 (command-shaped word). A token is command-shaped when it matches /^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$/: lowercase first letter, then lowercase letters, digits, `_` or `-`. A dot, an uppercase letter or any other character disqualifies it. - R2 (inline span). After the existing path check (unchanged), an inline span is a command claim only when its first token is command-shaped AND one of: (a) the first token is a known launcher: adlc npx npm pnpm yarn bun bunx node deno git gh docker make python python3 pip cargo go curl sh bash; (b) a later token is a flag (/^--?[A-Za-z]/); (c) the span starts with `$ ` (an explicit shell prompt, stripped before reading the first token). A single bare word that is not a launcher is a name, not a command. - R3 (fenced block). A fenced block yields claims only when its info string is empty or its first word is a shell language: sh bash zsh shell console shell-session terminal fish ksh. Inside such a block a line is a command claim only when its first token (after the existing `$ `/`> ` prompt strip) is command-shaped; the existing path handling of a line is unchanged. - R4 (linked code span). A code span that is the entire text of a markdown link whose target is an absolute http(s) URL, as in [`docs/x.md`](https://example.com/x), yields no claim. A link with a relative target is unchanged. - R5. Script references (`npm run X`, `pnpm X`, `yarn X`) are unchanged. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA. AC1 Name-shaped inline spans give no command claim: `execute.before`, `advisoryHooks`, `edit`, `write`, `adversarial-review`, `retry.maxAttempts`, `typescript`, `node_modules`, `SKILL.md`, `server.baseUrl`, `lint-rules.profile.yml`, `gpt-4.1-mini`, `claude-sonnet-4-5`, `spec_hash`, `PreToolUse`, `compare before.json after.json`, `refname is ambiguous`. Verify: node --test packages/skill-rot/test/command-claims.test.mjs AC2 Invocation-shaped inline spans still give a command claim on their first token: `ls -la` -> ls, `definitely-not-a-binary-xyz --flag` -> definitely-not-a-binary-xyz, `npx adversarial-review` -> npx, `git` -> git, `$ removed-cli-xyz` -> removed-cli-xyz, `pg_dump -Fc db` -> pg_dump. Verify: node --test packages/skill-rot/test/command-claims.test.mjs AC3 Fences: no claim from ```ts `const x = 1`, ```json, ```text or ```yaml lines, or from a box-drawing diagram line in an unlabelled fence; a command claim from ```bash `removed-cli-xyz build`, ```console `$ git status`, and an unlabelled fence's `git status`. Verify: node --test packages/skill-rot/test/command-claims.test.mjs AC4 [`docs/x.md`](https://github.com/o/r/blob/main/docs/x.md) gives no path claim; [`docs/x.md`](../docs/x.md) and a bare `docs/x.md` still give one. Verify: node --test packages/skill-rot/test/command-claims.test.mjs AC5 Real rot still fails the gate end to end: the real `bin/skill-rot.mjs`, run in a temp repo whose only skill documents `removed-cli-xyz --version` in a bash fence, exits 2 and names the command; a skill whose only spans are the AC1 names exits 0 and reports it as having no claims. Verify: node --test packages/skill-rot/test/command-claims.test.mjs AC6 The real `plugins/adlc-opencode/skill/adlc.md` yields no command claim named adversarial-review, execute.before, edit, write or advisoryHooks. Verify: node --test packages/skill-rot/test/command-claims.test.mjs AC7 The existing skill-rot suites stay green. A fixture that used a bare single word as a command changes only its input text (for example `ls` -> `ls -la`); no assertion is removed or weakened. Verify: node --test packages/skill-rot/test/*.test.mjs, and `git diff "$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)" -- packages/skill-rot/test | grep -E '^-\s*assert'` prints nothing. AC8 `packages/skill-rot/README.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/skill-rot.mdx` state R1-R4 and the launcher and shell-language lists. Verify: grep -c -e 'command-shaped' -e 'shell-session' -e 'launcher' packages/skill-rot/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/skill-rot.mdx (each count > 0). AC9 Full suite and PR gates green. Verify: npm run preflight OUT OF SCOPE. A per-span opt-out marker; shell continuation lines and shell functions defined inside a block; checking that `adlc ` exists; script-reference scanning inside non-shell fences; the C10 wording in ADLC.md; skill text elsewhere in the repo (part 2 below fixes only the deployed links). TIER. `packages/skill-rot` is not a trust-root package (not rails-guard, prosecute, gate-manifest or build-gate), so a same-model P5 is sufficient; confirm with `adlc prosecute tier-check` if in doubt. PART 2 — DEPLOYED DOC LINKS. PROBLEM. Plugin markdown is copied into consumer repositories or plugin caches, away from this repo's `docs/` tree. `/adlc-init` / `npx @adlc/opencode init` copies `plugins/adlc-opencode/skill/adlc.md` verbatim to `.opencode/skills/adlc/SKILL.md` (`plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/scaffold.mjs`, deploySkills). Its section "Rail enforcement in this harness" names `docs/ci/rails-guard.yml` and links [`docs/integrations/opencode.md`](../../../docs/integrations/opencode.md). Both files exist here and in neither place a consumer has, so the link dangles and `adlc skill-rot .opencode/skills` reports both as stale paths. The same relative-link pattern appears in exactly three other deployed files: `plugins/adlc-cursor/rules/adlc.mdc` (../../../docs/integrations/cursor.md, plus a bare `docs/ci/rails-guard.yml`), and `plugins/adlc-cursor/agents/prosecutor.md` and `plugins/adlc-claude-code/agents/prosecutor.md` (../../../docs/review-lenses/text-scanning-gates.md). Measured with `git ls-files 'plugins/**/*.md' 'plugins/**/*.mdc' 'skills/**/*.md'` minus README/CHANGELOG/test files: these are the only four relative links, and none resolves inside its plugin. The OpenCode router and the Cursor rule are GENERATED: their text lives in `scripts/router/router-model.mjs` (harness `rail-enforcement` sections) and `node scripts/router/gen-routers.mjs` writes the six routers; `scripts/test/router-drift.test.mjs` requires the committed files to equal the generator output byte for byte. Edit the model, then regenerate; never hand-edit a router. DECISIONS (full reasoning in `.adlc/specs/deployed-doc-links.md`). D1 Use absolute `https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/blob/main/` URLs. This follows the precedent set for #820 in PR #1377 (`plugins/adlc-cursor/command/adlc-spec.md`, pinned by `plugins/adlc-cursor/test/packaging.test.mjs`). Pinning to a release tag is rejected: every release would have to rewrite the links, and nothing does that today. D2 Fix the source, not the deploy step. `scaffold.mjs` decides migration and de-duplication by comparing the deployed file with the source byte for byte (deploySkills: `readFileSync(outFile) === source`), and the other harnesses (Claude Code marketplace, Cursor, skills.sh) do not deploy through it, so a deploy-time rewrite would fix one harness and break the comparison. D3 Keep the code-span link text, for example [`docs/ci/rails-guard.yml`](https://...) in the ADLC repo, so a reader still sees the file name. The sibling skill-rot ticket (R4: a code span that is the whole text of an absolute-URL link is not a claim) keeps it from reading as a local path. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA. B-AC1 In `scripts/router/router-model.mjs`, the opencode and cursor `rail-enforcement` sections link `docs/ci/rails-guard.yml` and their integration doc (`docs/integrations/opencode.md`, `docs/integrations/cursor.md`) with https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/blob/main/... URLs. The regenerated `plugins/adlc-opencode/skill/adlc.md` and `plugins/adlc-cursor/rules/adlc.mdc` match. Verify: node scripts/router/gen-routers.mjs --check && node --test scripts/test/router-drift.test.mjs B-AC2 Both `agents/prosecutor.md` files link docs/review-lenses/text-scanning-gates.md by the absolute main URL. Verify: node --test scripts/test/deployed-doc-links.test.mjs B-AC3 New test `scripts/test/deployed-doc-links.test.mjs`: (a) no tracked markdown file under plugins/

/ (except README.md, CHANGELOG.md and test/) or skills// has a relative link target that resolves outside plugins/

/ or skills// or names a missing file; (b) every https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/(blob|tree)/main/ link in those files names a path that exists in this repo; (c) the test fails on a fixture containing ](../../../docs/x.md), so it bites. Verify: node --test scripts/test/deployed-doc-links.test.mjs B-AC4 The real deployed router yields no path claim from its rail-enforcement section: running @adlc/skill-rot's extractClaims over `plugins/adlc-opencode/skill/adlc.md` gives no path claim beginning `docs/`. Verify: node --test scripts/test/deployed-doc-links.test.mjs B-AC5 Deployment still copies verbatim and the deployed copy equals the source. Verify: node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/scaffold.test.mjs plugins/adlc-cursor/test/packaging.test.mjs B-AC6 Full suite and PR gates green. Verify: npm run preflight OUT OF SCOPE (listed in the spec for a follow-up issue). The many bare code-span mentions of ADLC-repo files in other deployed markdown, such as `docs/interrogation-protocol.md`, `docs/ci/adlc-maintenance.yml`, `docs/ci/rails-guard.yml` in the shared router prose and the init commands, and `scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs`. Also `scripts/test/rails-guard-workflow-hashes.json`, which the shared P5 router prose lists as a trust-root file and which does not exist even in this repo. A deploy-time rewrite in scaffold.mjs. Pinning links to a release tag. Plugin README links (READMEs are not deployed into consumer repos). DEPENDS ON part 1 for B-AC4 (R4). TIER: scripts/router and plugin markdown are not trust-root paths (the trust-root plugin paths are plugins/adlc-opencode/lib, the hook directories and rails-checker.mjs), so a same-model P5 is sufficient.
title: skill-rot: count only invocation-shaped code spans as commands, and link ADLC docs from deployed plugin markdown by absolute URL
